app.a: No — not you, and not the person scanning. A phone camera is enough, and your messages open in the browser.

number.a: Never. Whoever scans the sticker sees no phone number, no name, no email, no address and no plate.

price.a: A single payment of {price} per sticker, plus delivery. No subscription.

receive.a: By notification on your phone and by email. They also stay in your own dashboard.

pay.a: Cash on delivery. We deliver to all 58 wilayas.

activate.q: How do I activate my sticker?
activate.a: With the private code printed on a separate slip, never on the sticker itself. Knowing the QR address alone is therefore not enough to claim a car.

abuse.a: The number of messages per hour is limited, and you can deactivate your sticker at any time from your dashboard.

change.a: Peel the sticker off or deactivate it in your dashboard, then activate a new one on the other car.

emergency.a: No. AutoLink is not an emergency service. If there is immediate danger, contact the appropriate emergency services.

retention.q: How long do you keep messages?

privacy.metaDescription: What AutoLink collects, why, and how long it is kept.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: {company} operates AutoLink. This page explains what we collect, why, and how long we keep it.

sections.title: What we collect
body: For the owner: an email address, a hashed password, the vehicle details you enter and, if you order, your delivery details.
For the person scanning: the reason chosen, the message written, an optional way to reach them back, and a random session id. No account is created.

sections.title: What we never show
body: Your phone number, name, email, address and plate number are never shown to the person scanning the sticker.

sections.title: IP addresses
body: IP addresses are never stored in the clear. They are turned into an irreversible fingerprint, used only to limit abuse.

sections.title: Retention
body: Messages are deleted automatically {period}. Orders are kept for accounting and delivery follow-up.

sections.title: Trackers
body: No third-party analytics, no advertising pixel, no profiling. One technical cookie is used for the session.

sections.title: Your rights
body: To access, correct or delete your data, write to {email}. Postal address: {address}.

terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the AutoLink service and buying the stickers.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By ordering or using an AutoLink sticker, you accept the terms below, offered by {company}.

sections.title: The service
body: AutoLink lets someone notify a vehicle owner from a QR sticker, without seeing the owner's contact details.

sections.title: Not an emergency service
body: AutoLink is not an emergency service. If there is immediate danger, contact the appropriate emergency services.

sections.title: Ordering and payment
body: The sticker is sold at the price shown at the time of the order, payable in cash on delivery. Delivery fees depend on the wilaya and are shown before you confirm.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: Messages must stay related to the vehicle. Insults, harassment, advertising and repeated messages without reason are forbidden and may lead to a block.

sections.title: Availability
body: We do our best to keep the service available, without being able to guarantee uninterrupted access.

sections.title: Contact
body: For any question about these terms: {email} — {address}.
